records.title: Child Development and Learning
records.header: EDPSY 302 Child Development and Learning (5) SSc
records.text: EDPSY 302 Child Development and Learning (5) SSc Uses readings, discussions, naturalistic observations, and "virtual" children to understand the different ways children develop - physically, cognitively, social-emotionally, in language and literacy, and in approaches to learning - during early childhood, the interplay between each of these domains and the environmental context, and the theories about the developmental mechanisms underlying these changes.

records.title: Adolescent Development
records.text: EDPSY 304 Adolescent Development (5) Students use readings, discussion, and interview data to understand adolescent development. Discusses multiple domains of development, as well as the contextually situated nature of adolescence. Highlights implications for educators, policy makers, and others who serve the needs of adolescents throughout the course. Course overlaps with: B EDUC 481.

records.title: Applied Child Development and Learning
records.header: EDPSY 305 Applied Child Development and Learning (5) SSc
records.text: EDPSY 305 Applied Child Development and Learning (5) SSc Examination of the latest research on brain development in early childhood and the application of this knowledge in the creation of learning environments that promote physical, language, cognitive, social, and emotional development. The roles of family, classroom, and community provide context to build relationships that support each child's development.

records.title: Learning and Teaching in our Changing World: Insights from Experience and Research
records.header: EDPSY 406 Learning and Teaching in our Changing World: Insights from Experience and Research (5) SSc
records.text: EDPSY 406 Learning and Teaching in our Changing World: Insights from Experience and Research (5) SSc Human learning in the educational setting. Cognition, development, learning, motivation, affective processes, and socialization. Emphasis on skills in influencing classroom learning and discipline.

records.title: Bullying, Revenge, and Belonging: Cultural Perspectives on Social Power
records.header: EDPSY 420 Bullying, Revenge, and Belonging: Cultural Perspectives on Social Power (4) SSc, DIV
records.text: EDPSY 420 Bullying, Revenge, and Belonging: Cultural Perspectives on Social Power (4) SSc, DIV Examines theories and research on bullying, revenge, and bystander behavior with a particular focus on cultural norms. Identifies the institutional, social, emotional, and ethical characteristics and processes that support exploitive relationships, revenge and their inclusive alternatives. Practical interventions are presented and evaluated.

records.title: Introduction to Educational Measurement and Analytics
records.header: EDPSY 490 Introduction to Educational Measurement and Analytics (5) NSc, RSN
records.text: EDPSY 490 Introduction to Educational Measurement and Analytics (5) NSc, RSN Introduces core concepts in measurement scales, sampling distributions (frequentist perspective), null hypothesis significance testing, confidence intervals, and power for 1- and 2-group z/t/chi/F tests, simple linear correlation and regression, and scale reliability and validity (foundational classic test theory). Covers basic coding skills for data analysis and visualization. Recommended: coursework in either pre-algebra or algebra.

records.title: Educational Measurement Design and Implementation
records.header: EDPSY 491 Educational Measurement Design and Implementation (5) RSN
records.text: EDPSY 491 Educational Measurement Design and Implementation (5) RSN Covers how to design and implement instruments like surveys and assessments for measuring latent constructs such as learning, belonging, or engagement. Concepts include the science of item writing, piloting whole instruments, and preliminary data collection. Also covers use of software for data collection and analysis. Prerequisite: EDPSY 490.

records.title: Educational Analytics for Linear Regression and Latent Variable Models
records.header: EDPSY 492 Educational Analytics for Linear Regression and Latent Variable Models (5) RSN
records.text: EDPSY 492 Educational Analytics for Linear Regression and Latent Variable Models (5) RSN Covers foundational understanding and application of two interrelated tools: multiple linear regression and structural equation (SEM) modeling. Emphasizes modeling latent (unobserved) variables and the treatment of measurement error for scales measured by continuous items. Prerequisite: EDPSY 490.

records.title: Educational Analytics for Logistic Regression and Item Response Theory Models
records.header: EDPSY 493 Educational Analytics for Logistic Regression and Item Response Theory Models (5) RSN
records.text: EDPSY 493 Educational Analytics for Logistic Regression and Item Response Theory Models (5) RSN Covers foundational understanding and application of two interrelated tools: multiple logistic regression and item response theory (IRT) modeling. Emphasizes modeling latent (unobserved) variables and the treatment of measurement error for scales measured by categorical items. Prerequisite: EDPSY 490.
